profile.headline: Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase & Co.
profile.summary: Software engineer working on cloud-based real-time streaming systems. I build event-driven pipelines on AWS using technologies like Apache Flink, Kafka, Cassandra, and Kubernetes to support high-volume internal workflows. Before this, I worked with Java and Spring Batch on microservice applications backed by Oracle on-prem. I’m motivated by helping people, whether that's improving things for customers or making life easier for coworkers. I value clarity, patience, and making engineering work smoother for the people around me.

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Working on real-time streaming systems on AWS using Apache Flink, Kafka, Cassandra, and Kubernetes (EKS)
• Contribute to the design, development, and operation of high-volume event pipelines and cloud migration efforts
• Focus on performance tuning, distributed data modeling, and resilient async I/O patterns
• Collaborate with multiple engineering teams consuming platform outputs that influence customer-facing behavior
• Mentor junior engineers and serve as a resource for Cassandra data modeling and performance questions
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Apache Kafka and +3 skills

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer on a full stack engineering team working to connect disparate systems together to create a better and more natural holistic customer experience.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description: Provide support to faculty and staff, and visitors with departmental guidance. Assist with data entry, organizational needs, inventory management, and mailing needs.
